The home features a functional layout with spacious rooms and solid fundamentals, making it ideal for a rental or value-add project. With modest updates, investors can increase both rental income and overall property value. Based on current market conditions, similar properties in the area may achieve  rents in the range of 1100 to1400 per month, depending on condition and amenities.
At this rent level, the property has the potential to deliver an attractive return, with room to improve cash flow through strategic upgrades and efficient management. The yard further enhances tenant appeal and marketability.
Very desirable 3/3 Double.  Property is in good condition with long term upper tenant that would like to stay if possible.  Rent for upper is 1200 per month and is paid prior to the end of the month,  Close to Hyde Park and shopping.  Close to public transportation and schools.
  A great investment opportunity for investor to build or add to portfolio. Whether you’re looking to expand your portfolio or secure a property with upside potential, this is a smart addition in a consistently active rental market.
